source_reference: Product event export, cohort funnel query v3 (AN-01)
population_or_sample: New accounts with 3+ seats signed 2026-01-01 to 2026-05-31 (n=412)
finding: 34% of accounts (140/412) met the first-team-value threshold within 30 days of signature; 89% (367/412) had an admin login within 7 days and 11% (45/412) had none
limitations: The first-team-value threshold is an analytics convention, not validated with customers; reasons for non-login are not visible in events

source_reference: Product event export joined to ledger sync log (AN-02)
population_or_sample: New accounts with 3+ seats signed 2026-01-01 to 2026-05-31 (n=412)
finding: Median 12 days from signature to first real invoice synced to the ledger; median 23 days where the first sync attempt failed vs 9 days where it succeeded; 22% never attempted a ledger connection within 30 days.
limitations: Correlation only: failing and slow accounts may differ in size or ledger vendor; re-cut on attempters in EVD-2026-0021

source_reference: Ledger connector sync error log (OR-01) and case trace (OR-02)
population_or_sample: All first sync attempts in cohort (n=321 accounts, 78% of cohort); trace of 30 rejected first postings
finding: 39% of first sync attempts failed; 72% of failures were tax-rate or revenue-account mapping mismatches. The auto-matcher assigns unmatched tax rates to the ledger's default code without flagging them; in a trace of 30 rejected first postings, 22 carried that default code and the other 8 carried a pair the admin had edited by hand
limitations: Error categories come from connector codes; the 30-case trace was a convenience sample of the most recent rejections; one ledger vendor's errors are coded less specifically

source_reference: Help desk tickets, first 45 days after signature (SL-01)
population_or_sample: 1,240 tickets from the cohort
finding: 38% of tickets tagged sync or mapping, 17% roles and permissions, 9% import; mapping tickets have the highest reopen rate (27%)
limitations: Tags applied by agents with inconsistent rules; customers who never contact support are absent; ticket closure rules were not reviewed

population_or_sample: 14 admins: 9 from accounts that had not met the threshold by day 30, 5 from accounts that had
finding: 6 of 9 admins from stalled accounts said set-up paused while they waited for their accountant to confirm which tax codes and accounts to use; several sent screenshots by email and did not know when to expect a reply
limitations: Recruited from admins who answered an email invitation; no admins from never-logged-in accounts; counts describe the sample, not the population

population_or_sample: Same 14 admins as EVD-2026-0005
finding: 8 of 14 admins said they would not put their team on Ledgerly until one real invoice had landed correctly in the books; admins from stalled accounts described checking the ledger by hand after each sync
limitations: Stated intent (said) plus reported behaviour; not linked to each admin's invite events

population_or_sample: 4 external accountants from 2 firms serving Ledgerly customers
finding: Accountants receive mapping questions as screenshots with no context about the client's plan or invoice types; 3 of 4 said clients do not give them a login because each login costs a paid seat; none are paid for this work
limitations: Very small sample from 2 firms recruited through one customer referral

population_or_sample: New accounts with 3+ seats signed 2026-01-01 to 2026-05-31 (n=412)
finding: 84% of sent invites were accepted within 7 days; 58% of accounts sent at least one invite within 30 days of signature
limitations: Acceptance measured per invite, not per account; bounced emails are not logged separately; 14-day invite rate not yet cut

population_or_sample: All session requests from the cohort submitted through the request form (n=187)
finding: Median 6 business days from session request to session; 31% of requests came from accounts under 10 seats and were declined under the tier policy; specialists logged a median 1.4 hours per onboarded account
limitations: Requests made through chat are not captured; logged hours are self-reported

source_reference: Onboarding and pricing policy v4, effective 2025-10-01 (DOC-01)
population_or_sample: Policy document
finding: Live set-up sessions are offered only to accounts with 10 or more seats; every login, including external advisers, consumes a paid seat
limitations: States policy, not how exceptions are granted in practice

source_reference: Shadowing of onboarding sessions, notes OS01-OS11
population_or_sample: 11 sessions run by 4 of 6 specialists
finding: Specialists spent a median 22 of 45 minutes on tax-rate and account mapping; in 7 of 11 sessions the admin phoned or messaged their accountant during the call
limitations: Only qualifying accounts (10+ seats) observed; specialists knew they were being observed

population_or_sample: 96 responses from the cohort (23% response rate)
finding: 71% agreed that setting up Ledgerly was easy; 88% of respondents had sent a real invoice vs 64% of the whole cohort
limitations: Response skews to accounts that got further; read as a completer view, it does not contradict EVD-2026-0002

population_or_sample: Head of Sales and 2 sales managers
finding: Teammates miss invitation emails because spam filters catch them, and this is the main reason accounts stall
limitations: Belief not backed by data; contradicted by EVD-2026-0008

population_or_sample: Head of Customer Success and 3 CS managers
finding: Admins who sign in the last week of a month postpone set-up until month-end close is over
limitations: Not tested; signature date vs month-end has not been analysed

source_reference: In-app set-up checklist A/B test EXP-25-04 (readout)
population_or_sample: New accounts with 3+ seats signed 2025-04-01 to 2025-08-31 (n=388; 194 per arm)
finding: Checklist raised checklist completion by 19 points; first team value within 30 days was 31% (treatment) vs 30% (control), a difference of +1 point with a 95% interval of about -8 to +10 points: no detectable effect
limitations: Could detect only effects of about 13 points or more (80% power); ran before policy v4 took effect on 2025-10-01 and before the current connector version; all 30-day windows had closed by 2025-09-30

source_reference: Billing records joined to cohort outcomes (AN-04)
population_or_sample: Accounts with 3+ seats signed 2025-07-01 to 2026-02-28 (n=604)
finding: 90-day logo retention was 96% (197/205) for accounts that met the team-value threshold within 30 days vs 81% (323/399) for those that did not
limitations: Observational; larger accounts are more likely both to meet the threshold and to stay, so the gap is not a causal effect

source_reference: Admin interviews round 1 (S01-S14) read against OR-01
population_or_sample: 5 admins with an in-house bookkeeper vs 9 relying on an external accountant
finding: Stall at mapping appears concentrated in accounts with an external accountant: all 5 in-house admins completed mapping in one sitting. Reasoning: in-house admins had the knowledge on hand; external-accountant admins waited on a reply
limitations: Inference from 14 interviews; the 5 in-house admins are the same 5 recruited from accounts that met the threshold, so the comparison is confounded by selection on outcome; cannot be checked in data until EVD-2026-0018 is resolved

population_or_sample: CRM account schema
finding: Open question: what share of new accounts keep their books with an external accountant? No field records it, so the segment in EVD-2026-0017 cannot be sized
limitations: Could be approximated from sales call notes; not attempted

population_or_sample: 6 team members from 4 accounts
finding: Teammates invited before approval rules were set sent invoices directly; admins then restricted permissions, and 4 of 6 teammates hit an unexplained 'you cannot send this invoice' block in their first week
limitations: Small sample, all from accounts that met the threshold; team members from stalled accounts not reached

source_reference: Help desk tickets tagged roles and permissions (SL-02)
population_or_sample: 211 tickets (17% of the 1,240 in EVD-2026-0004)
finding: Most frequent permission ticket: a teammate cannot send or edit an invoice after approval rules were applied; 61% raised by the teammate, not the admin
limitations: Same tagging limitations as EVD-2026-0004

source_reference: Cohort re-cut AN-05 under analysis plan AP-01 (cut points pre-specified 2026-06-20)
population_or_sample: New accounts with 3+ seats signed 2026-01-01 to 2026-05-31 (n=412)
finding: Re-run confirms 140/412 met the threshold. Among the 321 accounts that attempted a sync: 284 had a synced invoice by day 30 (median 12 days); first synced invoice within 7 days (pre-specified cut, n=80) met the threshold at 55% (44/80) vs 31% (75/241) otherwise; within seat bands 3-9: 52% (28/54) vs 29% (49/170), 10+: 62% (16/26) vs 37% (26/71). First sync failed (n=125): 26% (32/125) vs succeeded (n=196): 44% (87/196). Invites within 30 days: 81% (65/80) early, 58% (139/241) later, 38% (35/91) never connected. Of the 91 accounts that never connected a ledger, 23% (21/91) met the threshold
limitations: Correlation only; stratified on seat band only, not on ledger vendor; the 7-day cut was the only cut examined; Jun-Aug 2026 cohorts not yet included

population_or_sample: API documentation of the 3 supported ledgers
finding: Two of the three ledgers expose a change feed that returns edits, reversals and re-postings for the previous 90 days; the third exposes no change history
limitations: Documentation, not a tested integration; retention may differ by customer plan

population_or_sample: 45 accounts with no admin login within 7 days
finding: Open question: why do 11% of admins not log in within 7 days, and what do they expect to happen first? Email recruitment reached none of them
limitations: Would be answered by phone recruitment (OPP-0007)

population_or_sample: 91 accounts that never connected a ledger
finding: Open question: how do accounts that never connect a ledger invoice, and do they see the connection as necessary at all?
limitations: No interview or event data covers what happens outside the product

population_or_sample: Team members of accounts that did not meet the threshold
finding: Open question: what do team members in stalled accounts experience when they are invited, or while they wait to be?
limitations: All 6 team members interviewed came from accounts that met the threshold
